title: Map of My Home
description: For ages 6–9 with an adult: draw a simple map of your home, with a star on your favourite place.

body.heading: Draw the rooms
paragraphs: Imagine you are a bird flying over your home, looking down. Draw each room as a box.
Add the doors as gaps and the big things inside: the table, the sofa, your bed.

body.heading: Mark the treasure
paragraphs: Put a star on your favourite place in the whole home. Tell your adult why it wins.
Now follow your map: walk from the front door to the star, checking the map as you go.

takeaway: A map is a drawing of a place that helps you find your way.
safetyNotes: Maps stay at home with your family; they are not for sharing with strangers.
screenFreeExtension: Draw a map of your garden or your street from above, like a bird would see it.
